topics.title: 3-Axis Accelerometer Ear Tags & Rumination Monitoring
topics.objective: Track daily chewing minutes and head movements to detect sub-acute ruminal acidosis and early metabolic disorders.
topics.exercise: Write a signal processing script identifying cows whose rumination time drops by more than 15% within a 24-hour window.

topics.title: Automated Estrus Detection & Timed Artificial Insemination
topics.objective: Monitor sudden spikes in walking activity and restlessness to calculate optimal insemination windows.
topics.exercise: Formulate an automated alert workflow notifying herd managers 12 hours after detected peak estrus activity.

topics.title: Automated Milking Systems (AMS) & In-Line Milk Quality
topics.objective: Measure milk electrical conductivity, optical somatic cell count, and quarter-level temperature to diagnose mastitis.
topics.exercise: Build an in-line decision pipeline diverting non-compliant milk automatically and scheduling teat disinfection sprays.

topics.title: Intra-Rumen Wireless Sensor Boluses
topics.objective: Analyze real-time reticulorumen temperature and pH measurements transmitted via UHF/LoRaWAN to cloud gateways.
topics.exercise: Develop an event detector parsing water drinking frequency and flagging prolonged rumen fever episodes.

topics.title: Individual Dry Matter Intake (DMI) & Biometric Walk-Over Scales
topics.objective: Track body weight trends and individual robotic feed dispenser intake to calculate herd feed conversion efficiency (FCE).
topics.exercise: Create an automated feed allocation model adjusting concentrate rations based on days in milk (DIM) and daily milk yield.
